NAME: Debug verification plan
details: Block 12: debug_top with jtag_tap, dtm, dmi_cdc, debug_module and sba_master. Source: GARUDA-DEBUG-SPEC-001, RISC-V Debug 0.13, IEEE 1149.1, decision D-18. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. This block holds the only asynchronous clock boundary in the chip.

details: All 16 states and every transition on TMS.
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim (JTAG agent). Today: no check of the state machine itself; scans exercise part of it

NAME: a_tap_fsm
details: The next state is the standard's function of the current state and TMS.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/debug/debug_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.
